info.description: Unofficial, no SLA. Read-only river levels and discharge for the rivers flowing into the Netherlands. Rate-limited per client (429 with Retry-After). Not an official warning service. Unknown or repeated query parameters are a 400. Every 200 body carries an `attribution` array that lists exactly the sources it names.
